changes: Added an Item / Weapon Database inside the Player Inventory tab.
Added inventory database search/filter by item name, FormID, EditorID, category, source, and notes.
Added item category filter and Have/Missing status filter.
Shows whether each database item is already in the loaded save inventory or missing.
For items already present in the save, Set Existing Item Count updates New Count automatically.
For items already present in the save, Add Amount To Existing adds the chosen amount onto New Count automatically.
For missing items, Copy AddItem Command copies player.additem <FormID> <amount>.
Find In Inventory jumps from a database item to the matching player inventory row when present.
safety_notes: Direct save editing still only changes existing inventory rows.
Missing/new item insertion is not enabled yet because the save row structure still needs to be mapped safely.
Missing items are handled through generated console additem commands for now.
